subject.title: [Feature]: When messages are merged and processed, the agent event is expected to carry the original runId(s)

question: Should merged queued Gateway events preserve the executed `runId` and add an original/source run ID array, or should merged execution reuse one of the queued source run IDs as the public run ID?
rationale: Current source can keep queued identities internally, but this issue proposes competing public API semantics on an M4 stable Gateway event contract.

options.title: Add additive lineage array
options.body: Preserve the executed `runId` and add a named array such as `sourceRunIds` or `originalRunIds` to public event schemas and projections.

options.title: Reuse one queued ID
options.body: Make merged execution appear under the first or last queued source ID, simplifying some clients while hiding multi-source lineage.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Leave clients to correlate through accepted/final events and history, accepting that merged queued execution is not one-to-one in live events.

recommendation.title: Add additive lineage array
recommendation.body: Preserve the executed `runId` and add a named array such as `sourceRunIds` or `originalRunIds` to public event schemas and projections.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a Gateway protocol/product semantics choice, and steipete is the strongest routing signal from issue timeline and Gateway history.
